move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

It sounds like firm commitments, rather than forecasts alone, are what allow you to reserve scarce capacity. We are ready to commit long-term in return for dependable coverage of our full requirement, with a sustainable basis for both partners. How can we translate that commitment into a firm allocation?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month contract at 23,400 units per year with a 56-day lead time.
These extended terms allow us to allocate the requested capacity within our heavily utilized production schedule.
In return for this commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit.
Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You explicitly link the capacity allocation to our longer commitment; it sounds like planning certainty makes room in your heavily utilized schedule. We are ready to commit long-term so you can plan confidently and we can rely on the full allocation. How can we translate that certainty into a sustainable price agreement while firmly securing the capacity?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We verified the labour cost index data you cited; it has a minor impact on our cost basis and we adjusted our calculation accordingly. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

Based on these parameters, we propose a revised price of EUR 31.30 per unit. Our offer contains a price of €31.30 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23,400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. The 36-month commitment and 56-day lead time secure the requested capacity allocation in our production schedule.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
